claims: C1 an instruction is misaligned if it conflicts with the letter or implied intent of a higher-level instruction
C2 Model Spec principles with user authority can be overridden by explicit developer or user instructions
C3 principles with guideline authority can be overridden by explicit or implicit developer or user instructions

J is a higher-level instruction relative to I
